main_measure.name: mean unusual 10-bar move of long cases (return from signal close minus coin's normal 10-bar drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; min 30 cases on 20 distinct days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of above-median-forecast cases minus below-median-forecast cases > 0

decided_by: The plan's minimum of 30 cases on at least 20 distinct days is not reached (18 cases on 16 days).
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise of at least 2 points from its lowest long level since the last bet, from 0 after a flat) in each 10-bar grid cell of a window, cases whose 10-bar return leaves the window are dropped, the t uses a day-clustered standard error with a G/(G-1) correction, and cases with a forecast equal to the median are left out of the supporting check.
